description: Uses syslog to add log entries to the host.

parameters.name: ident
parameters.description: Specify the name of application name which is sending the log to syslog. Default: "ansible_syslogger"

parameters.name: log_pid
parameters.description: Log the PID in brackets. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: This is the message to place in syslog.

examples:
- name: Simple Usage
  community.general.syslogger:
    msg: "I will end up as daemon.info"

- name: Send a log message with err priority and user facility with log_pid
  community.general.syslogger:
    msg: "Hello from Ansible"
    priority: "err"
    facility: "user"
    log_pid: true

- name: Specify the name of application which is sending log message
  community.general.syslogger:
    ident: "MyApp"
    msg: "I want to believe"
    priority: "alert"

return_values.name: ident
return_values.description: Name of application sending the message to log. Returned: always Sample: "ansible_syslogger"

return_values.name: log_pid
return_values.description: Log PID status. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message sent to syslog. Returned: always Sample: "Hello from Ansible"
